name: Oats Almond & Milk
ingredients_raw: Flour (wheat), sugar (cane sugar, liquid glucose, maltodextrin, invert sugar), vegetable fat (palm), oat flakes (15%), almond (5%), wheat bran, sodium bicarbonate, ammonium bicarbonate, sodium acid pyrophosphate, oat fiber, skim milk powder (1%), soy lecithin, mono , diglycerides of fatty acids (palm), diacetyle tartaric acid esters of mono , diglycerides (palm), salt, butter, vanilla , milk (artificial flavours), caramel colour (contains sulphite)
